catalog.label: «El pulgar del ingeniero», The Strand Magazine, vol. III (marzo de 1892)

parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes IX\. — El pulgar del ingeniero {{#dos_casos e:holmes q:dos_casos|De todos los problemas sometidos a mi amigo, el señor [[holmes|Sherlock Holmes]], sólo dos llegaron a él por mi intermedio: el del pulgar del señor Hatherley y el de la locura del [[coronel_warburton|coronel Warburton]].}} {{#verano_89 q:verano_89|Fue en el verano del 89, poco después de [[boda_de_watson|mi boda]], cuando ocurrieron los hechos que voy a resumir.}} {{#paddington p:paddington q:paddington|Como vivía a poca distancia de la estación de [[paddington|Paddington]], tenía algunos pacientes entre los empleados del ferrocarril.}} Una mañana, poco antes de las siete, me trajeron un paciente de la estación. La criada había dejado en la mesita la tarjeta de mi visitante: {{#tarjeta e:victor_hatherley q:tarjeta|«Señor [[victor_hatherley|Victor Hatherley]], ingeniero hidráulico, Victoria Street, 16 A (tercer piso).»}} {{#pulgar e:victor_hatherley q:pulgar|—Y ahora, doctor, quizá tenga usted la bondad de atenderme el pulgar o, mejor dicho, el sitio donde antes tenía el pulgar.}} {{#cuatro_dedos q:cuatro_dedos|Desenvolvió el pañuelo y tendió la mano: había cuatro dedos salientes y una horrible superficie roja y esponjosa donde debía estar el pulgar.}}

src_en.dos_casos: Of all the problems which have been submitted to my friend, Mr. Sherlock Holmes, for solution during the years of our intimacy, there were only two which I was the means of introducing to his notice—that of Mr. Hatherley’s thumb, and that of Colonel Warburton’s madness.
src_en.verano_89: It was in the summer of ’89, not long after my marriage, that the events occurred which I am now about to summarise.
src_en.paddington: as I happened to live at no very great distance from Paddington Station, I got a few patients from among the officials.
src_en.tarjeta: Mr. Victor Hatherley, hydraulic engineer, 16A, Victoria Street (3rd floor).
src_en.pulgar: And now, Doctor, perhaps you would kindly attend to my thumb, or rather to the place where my thumb used to be.
src_en.cuatro_dedos: There were four protruding fingers and a horrid red, spongy surface where the thumb should have been.
src_en.palancas: It was the clank of the levers and the swish of the leaking cylinder.
src_en.techo_negro: By its light I saw that the black ceiling was coming down upon me, slowly, jerkily, but, as none knew better than myself, with a force which must within a minute grind me to a shapeless pulp.
src_en.un_pie: The ceiling was only a foot or two above my head, and with my hand upraised I could feel its hard, rough surface.
src_en.cincuenta_guineas: I have lost my thumb and I have lost a fifty-guinea fee, and what have I gained?
src_en.experiencia: you have only to put it into words to gain the reputation of being excellent company for the remainder of your existence.
